Exchange the current refresh token for a new pair. Each refresh token works once.

get.description: Chronological home feed: the viewer's own posts and posts from people they follow (minus muted).

A person's own posts for their profile: only what the viewer is allowed to see, newest first.

Page and group posts stay on their Page/group; blocked users are 'not found'.

post.description: Flag a post for review. Reporting the same post again updates the earlier report.

get.description: Bookmarked posts the viewer can still see (deleted or now-private posts drop out).

Public posts from people the viewer doesn't follow, newest first.

Deliberately simple until ranking is designed (see roadmap §8A): sorting by a
live reaction COUNT across all posts doesn't scale and isn't explainable.

patch.description:
Approve/ban members and change roles.

Rules (prevents privilege escalation):
- Moderators may only change the status of plain members; they cannot change roles.
- Admins may change status and roles, but only the Page owner may grant or remove admin.
- Nobody can modify the Page owner or their own membership here.
